title: Last Year's #1 Fund Is This Year's Biggest Trap
hook: You picked the fund with the best five-star rating — and you just made the most predictable mistake in investing.
angle: 86% of top-performing funds fall out of the top quartile within 3 years — most investors never find out until they've compounded a $285,000 loss over 30 years
audience: Anyone who picks investments based on star ratings, recent performance rankings, or 'best of year' fund lists
key_numbers: 86% of top-rated funds drop out of top tier in 3 years
$285,000 lost on $100K over 30 years from chasing returns
$761K index vs $476K chaser over 30 years on same $100K
